methodological_rigor.justification: Competent observational study with RT-qPCR validation across independent public databases. Small sample (n=83) with only 15 paired longitudinal samples during therapy. Mann-Whitney U and Kaplan-Meier analysis appropriate but no multivariable survival analysis to adjust for confounders.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Case-control prognostic marker study with clear clinical relevance for risk stratification in pediatric ALL. Demonstrated correlation with disease burden and treatment response but lacks treatment impact demonstration. Plausible but unproven translational implications.

reporting_quality.justification: Most REMARK checklist items present but incomplete data availability statement. Some methodological details missing; references prior publication without full methods. Figures lack consistent error bar presentation.

novelty_literature.justification: First SETD4 investigation in ALL extending from breast cancer and NSCLC. Meaningful but incremental showing similar prognostic role as known SMYD2. Strong correlation suggests shared mechanism not novel discovery.

writing_presentation.justification: Well-organized with clear figures demonstrating dose-response and survival. Professional writing with informative literature contextualization. Adequately acknowledges limitations including small cohort size and limited follow-up samples.

key_strengths: Novel SETD4 investigation in ALL with independent microarray dataset validation
Mechanistically grounded in chromosome 21 ALL biology
key_concerns: Limited sample size with only 15 paired longitudinal samples constraining temporal conclusions
No multivariable survival analysis or covariate adjustment beyond univariate comparison
Unknown if SETD4 upregulation is driver or passenger event without functional validation
chief_reviewer.rationale: Competent but incremental biomarker study with appropriate methods and clinical relevance. Limited sample size and lack of functional mechanistic work restrict impact to Tier 3.
